notablePrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
